# 🪝 Print tool info

Shows the tool name, arguments, time and working directory before each tool call. Useful for learning how hooks work and for debugging what an agent does.

Install in Claude Code: `/plugin install print-tool-info@jaktestowac`. The hook runs `node`, so Node.js must be on your PATH.
